# World vendor assets

`pixi.min.mjs` is PixiJS **8.8.1** (`dist/pixi.min.mjs`), vendored for offline presentation.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@8.8.1/dist/pixi.min.mjs

Do not replace with the jsDelivr `+esm` rewrite — that build resolves `/npm/...` imports against the CDN and fails offline.
